programs.title: Unlocked
programs.desc: Unlocked is a home tour series focused on how much people across the globe spend on their housing, what they get for the money and what they had to sacrifice to make it happen. CNBC opens the doors to unique homes and introduces you to the people inside so you can see what it's like to live there and exactly how much it costs.

programs.title: CNBC Explains
programs.desc: ‘CNBC Explains' is a dynamic explainer series that dives deep into the forces shaping our world.
